Definition: a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe
BiblicalUsage: A gift is a present or offering, and the Bible shows it in every light: Moses says every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD, and the Preacher warns that a gift destroys the heart. Proverbs says he that hates gifts shall live, the psalm says God received gifts for men, and at Purim the Jews sent portions to one another.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gifts reveal what we trust: given freely they are worship, given to buy favour they are a bribe, and the line between them runs through the heart. The gift that destroys the heart is the one that buys a man, and the gift that blesses is the one that costs him nothing but love.
RelatedPeople: Moses; King Solomon; Queen Esther; Mordecai
